sentences.text: first information statement of Smt.Aruna S..
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused got married with CW-1 about 16 years ago.
Accused was doing Real Estate business and not providing basic needs to CW-1.

After the marriage, Accused was residing along with CW-1 at House No.106, 1st cross, Gurudatta layout Hosakerehalli, BSK 3rd stage and during her stay, Accused was abusing, assaulting and suspecting her and making galata to shut down the beauty parlor run by her.
Despite panchayath problem,could not get set right and Accused continued harassing CW-1.
On 20-11-2024 at 4-00 a.m accused abused her in bad words, assaulted by dragging her and thus subjected CW-1 to cruelty both physically and mentally in demand of dowry.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.552/2023 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of Giri nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid  3  C.C.No.309/2024 offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing him and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the Girinagar Police Station vs Giri Chowdary C on 5 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131852721/

sentences.text: The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
 6.
Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 4  C.C.No.309/2024  1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused person caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and thereby accused has committed the offence  punishable U/s.498A of IPC.?
2) what order?

8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.

sentences.text: She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed during the year 2008 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel  5  C.C.No.309/2024 between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile the Girinagar Police Station vs Giri Chowdary C on 5 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131852721/
4 prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused  6  C.C.No.309/2024 beyond reasonable doubt.
